lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Okay, last thing on the list. The name.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. The name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We said we'd land it this week, and we've been saying that for three weeks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What have we actually got? Meadow, Tilde, and the one you wince at.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Parcel. And I don't wince, I just can't say it out loud twice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So, nothing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Meadow's taken. There's a payments company called Meadow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course there is.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And nobody can spell Tilde. We'd be spelling it out on every call forever.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which puts us back on Parcel, which you can't say out loud twice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I don't know. I genuinely don't know what we call this thing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Me neither. We go round this every week and land in exactly the same place.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Read me the three again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Meadow, Tilde, Parcel.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Meadow's gone, Tilde's unspellable, Parcel's unsayable. That's the whole list.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We're stuck. That's what this is.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah. I've got nothing new.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Go on then. Anything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Honestly, at this point I'd take a suggestion from the kettle.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Let's leave the name and come back to it Thursday with fresh heads.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thursday. But we decide on Thursday, we don't do this again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Agreed. Thursday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Anything else on the list?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, that was the list. That's us.
